beats.vo_roman_urdu: Dekho… ye dono barabar lag rahe hain. Lekin inme se ek jhooth hai.
beats.vo_english: These two look the same size. One of them is lying.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Ye koi printing ki galti nahi. Ye naqshe ka tareeqa hai.
beats.vo_english: That's not a printing error — that's a projection.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Dunya gol hai, kagaz seedha. Gol ko seedha karne ke liye kuch na kuch tootna hi parega.
beats.vo_english: The Earth is round, the page is flat. Something has to give.
beats.map_action: 3D globe flatten; grid lines khinchti hain
beats.caption: burned-in

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Is tareeqe ne jahazron ko rasta diya… aur badle mein size le liya.
beats.vo_english: It saved navigation… and quietly spent the size.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Haqeeqat mein Africa, Greenland se [X] guna bada hai.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Jitna koi jagah pole ke qareeb, utni hi wo upar khinchti gayi. Isliye Greenland bada dikh gaya.
beats.vo_english: The closer a place is to the pole, the more it stretches upward.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: To kya har naqsha jhooth bolta hai? Chalo, teen tareeqe saamne rakhte hain.
beats.vo_english: So is every map wrong? Let's put three methods side by side.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Har projection kisi ek cheez ko bachata hai — shape, ya size, ya direction — aur doosri ko kharch karta hai.
beats.vo_english: Every projection saves one thing — shape, area, or direction — and spends another.
beats.caption: burned-in

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Isliye apne sheher ko bhi kabhi flat naqshe par na tolna.
beats.vo_english: So don't judge your own city by a flat map either.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Yaad rakho teen labels: SAABIT, MUKHTALIF, NA-MALOOM. Jo confirm na ho, usse confirm mat kehna.
beats.vo_english: Three labels: CONFIRMED, DISPUTED, UNKNOWN. Don't label a guess as a fact.

beats.vo_roman_urdu: Jawab ye nahi ke naqsha jhootha hai. Jawab ye hai ke har naqsha ek cheez chunta hai.
